notes: Status values: "party", "signed only", "neither (not listed by depositary)". A state absent from a depositary table is "neither". Two special cases on the 1954 Statelessness Convention: Madagascar is "neither (former party, denounced)" - UNTC prints its 1962 accession in brackets, footnote 6 says it denounced in 1965; China's row is empty (listed only for the Hong Kong application, footnote 3) so it is "neither (row listed for a footnote only)".
1954 Statelessness: UNTC says 23 signatories; the table has 22 rows with a signature date. The 23rd could not be found in the table and was not invented.
States listed = every state in any of these tables plus every state in treaties.json (UNTC ICERD/CEDAW/CRPD universe).

UNTC dates are of signature and of deposit of the instrument; reservations, declarations, objections and territorial applications (UNTC footnotes) are not transcribed - see the treaty URL. Footnote numbers are kept.
Marrakesh: the European Union is a member in its own right (key EU_). EU membership is NOT copied to EU member states; WIPO lists those states separately only if they joined themselves.
Marrakesh: a state can be a party whose in-force date is still in the future (e.g. recent accessions); in_force_date is kept.
